answer: Because the timing is logged against the echo challenge, the glacier audit can replay the dawn history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 204 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 2060 identities would post 2913 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
